name: set_runtime_mode
summary: Consumes one byte and calls sub_108693E0 with 0 when the byte is zero, otherwise 1.

name: conditional_angle_update
summary: For species +3 equal to 27, 28 or 31 and operand zero, requires three native helper predicates to return zero, scales the result of 0x10aa0ce0 by a species-dependent constant, and calls 0x10858e00. Other operands/species only advance. The game meaning of the scaled update is unconfirmed; this is not a proven general turn or angle setter.

operands.meaning: selector; zero enables the conditional path

control_flow: returns cursor + 2; no conditional marker block
domain_notes: The opcode has a conditional side effect, but does not encode an if/else structure. Preserve the native species and state guards.

name: angle_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero refreshes vectors, derives a threshold from the following byte, compares it with the absolute angular difference from sub_10855830, and advances through the 0x42 marker block on one side of the comparison. Selector one scans to the block terminator; other selectors advance one byte.

operands.meaning: threshold input when selector is zero

control_flow: handler returns a cursor; marker matching uses opcode 0x42 selectors 1/2

name: conditional_runtime_relation
summary: Selector zero continues into the 0x44 body only when runtime pointer +3172 is null or its +2040 word differs from the current +2040 word; then it skips/enters using the 0x44 marker. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer set by sub_108578A0 (array dword_1ED7AD2C, stride 3824, 40 entries), 0 = none

name: select_candidate_lane_by_flags
summary: Selector zero scans four global records, filters by active mask, current +2040, actor type +3, and a record flag, and writes the selected index to runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target); candidates are ranked by the float lane values at runtime +2740 + 4*i (cached per-player distances). Otherwise it scans the 0x45 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +2740 is the cached f32 distance for each player slot. The native comparison ranks eligible candidates by this distance; it is not an arbitrary weight.

name: conditional_lane_pair
summary: Selector zero reads a two-byte pair and compares it with the selected lane record fields at offsets +20/+21; mismatch scans the 0x46 marker block. Selector one scans to its terminator.

name: consume_runtime_flag_2729_branch
summary: Selector zero tests byte +2729: if nonzero, clears it and enters the body; otherwise skips to the matching else/end. Selector one skips to the end. This consumes a one-shot byte, not a linked-actor pointer, and does not wait.
writes: runtime +2729 (byte, cleared on a successful selector-zero test)

name: set_ai_delay_frames
summary: Stores the operand in actor +3228 as the AI delay in frames; while it is positive the per-frame runner 0x1085c5e0 only decrements it and skips the instruction interpreter, so the script resumes at the next instruction after that many frames.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 2; the cursor is kept and resumes once the delay reaches zero

name: bind_selected_player_ground_point
summary: Binds a ground-point offset profile for the player selected by +2612. If +2612 is 0xff, sets command kind +2581 to 1, +2582 to 0 and +2584 to -1; otherwise sets kind 11, player slot +2582 to +2612 & 0x0f and profile +2584 to the operand. Immediately copies all three fields to saved +3231/+3232/+3234. Later kind-11 resolution indexes the current-area ground-point table by the selected player ground number +2010, rotates the profile offset and adds it to that point. The opcode itself neither resolves the point nor moves the actor. DSL: self.bind_target_ground_point(profile) emits exactly 49 followed by the u8 profile; all 0..255 values decompile to this form and round-trip without adding 0x13 or 0x4d.

operands.meaning: ground-point offset profile, encoding range 0..255; only 0..3 have initialized native offset vectors

domain_notes: The parameter is a fixed native profile, not a player slot, action id or arbitrary distance. Values outside 0..3 leave the local offset uninitialized in the downstream resolver. The DSL accepts the complete u8 encoding range without claiming confirmed behavior for profiles 4..255.

Unlike 0x58, this handler synchronizes the saved command fields immediately. It uses the player domain regardless of any earlier monster-domain target. Opcode 0x06 command kind 11 retains its existing native form and is not rewritten as this method.

name: lane_mask_gate
summary: Selector zero continues when the current target is not 0xff and its player-detection bit in actor+2684 is set; otherwise it skips to the matching else/end. Selector one skips to the end.
domain_notes: +2684 is the player-detection mask updated by sub_1084F7C0 using area, distance, height, angle and obstruction checks; sub_10854B90/sub_10854BF0 can force detection after basic eligibility checks, so this is not a pure line-of-sight test.
sub_10854C70 refreshes +2687 and the per-player retention timer +2688+2*i while the detection bit is set; tracking may remain after detection clears.
The opcode indexes by +2612 & 0x0f and does not validate the target domain or rerun detection.

name: clear_selected_player_awareness_score
summary: When +2612 is not 0xff, clears the awareness score dword +2788 + 4*(+2612 & 0x0f). This score accumulates player activity while not in Attack mode and is consumed by awareness-trigger logic. It does not clear detection/tracking flags, retention timers or the hate score.
domain_notes: 0x108535c0 adds activity-dependent values. 0x108552c0 compares the score with the native threshold and may raise +2601, +2823 bit 0x10 and the player bit in +2821, then clears the consumed score.
No target-domain or slot-range validation is performed by this opcode.

name: clear_selected_player_hate_score
summary: When +2612 is not 0xff, clears the hate score dword +2824 + 4*(+2612 & 0x0f). This is the accumulated and decaying score used for target selection, not a timer. Detection/tracking flags, retention timers and awareness scores are unchanged.
domain_notes: 0x10852a80 adds weighted activity; 0x10852c10 applies species/state-dependent decay. Target selectors consume score tiers such as 50000 and 30000, then score ordering.
No target-domain or slot-range validation is performed by this opcode.

name: refresh_runtime_vectors
summary: Consumes the opcode and calls sub_108538B0 with the runtime object.

name: extend_request_countdown_2696
summary: Operand zero adds half of the configured base +2708 to the request countdown +2696, using signed integer division, and clamps the result to that base. A nonzero operand only advances. The corresponding countdown consumer 0x10856220 can raise pending byte +3192 and fired latch +2736 when the value reaches zero; the request game category remains unnamed.

operands.meaning: zero extends the countdown; nonzero has no writes

domain_notes: +2696/+2708 are a request countdown and its configured base, not per-player hate accumulators. This opcode does not clear the pending request or fired latch.

name: extend_request_countdown_2700
summary: Operand zero adds half of the configured base +2712 to the request countdown +2700, using signed integer division, and clamps the result to that base. A nonzero operand only advances. The corresponding countdown consumer 0x10856170 can raise pending byte +3191 and fired latch +2737 when the value reaches zero; the request game category remains unnamed. For species 104/112, 0x10864790 additionally scans the 40-entry em array and applies the same half-base refill to every other active actor of the same species, clearing each affected actor +2823 bit 0x02.

operands.meaning: zero extends the countdown; nonzero has no writes

domain_notes: +2700/+2712 are a request countdown and its configured base, not per-player hate accumulators. This opcode does not clear the pending request or fired latch.

name: extend_request_countdown_2704
summary: Operand zero adds half of the configured base +2716 to the request countdown +2704, using signed integer division, and clamps the result to that base. A nonzero operand only advances. The corresponding countdown consumer 0x10856290 can raise pending byte +3193 and fired latch +2735 when the value reaches zero; the request game category remains unnamed.

operands.meaning: zero extends the countdown; nonzero has no writes

domain_notes: +2704/+2716 are a request countdown and its configured base, not per-player hate accumulators. This opcode does not clear the pending request or fired latch.

name: runtime_phase_gate
summary: Selector zero skips its body when runtime +1040 (entity status byte) equals 4; otherwise it scans the 0x51 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: select_player_same_or_allowed_area
summary: Single-byte player-target selection. Filters tracked players using +2687, current target +1826, current area +2040, native class/eligibility tests and allowed-area rules. Applies native hate-score tiers and per-player distance ranking, with target-retention paths, then writes +2612. DSL: self.select_target_entity(EntityTarget::SameOrAllowedArea).
control_flow: consumes only the opcode; handler returns the incoming continuation cursor
domain_notes: +2740 + 4*i is the cached per-player distance, not an abstract weight. Within the high hate-score tiers the native comparison favors the greater distance; the fallback considers hate scores.
+1252 is the native per-actor class byte; the exact composite algorithm is preserved by the DSL strategy.

name: select_player_same_area
summary: Single-byte same-area player-target selection. Uses activity and tracking masks, +2040 area equality, +1252 class tests, hate-score tiers at +2824 and per-player distance +2740. Preserves native random fallback and species-specific retention/override paths, and writes +2612. DSL: self.select_target_entity(EntityTarget::SameArea).
control_flow: consumes only the opcode; handler returns the incoming continuation cursor
domain_notes: +2740 + 4*i is cached per-player distance. This complete native strategy is not equivalent to a pure nearest, farthest, random or maximum-hate selector.
The meaning of the species-specific +3268 field remains unresolved.

name: lane_record_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when the selected lane record is active, its +2042 byte is zero, and sub_10A94CE0 returns nonzero; otherwise it scans the 0x54 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: selected_player_hate_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero skips to the matching else/end when no player is selected or the selected player hate-score dword +2824 is below 30000. Selector one skips to the terminator. The compared value is a score, not a timer.

name: global_word_gate
summary: Selector zero reads a big-endian u16 operand and scans the 0x56 marker block when it differs from the word at global 0x1e8001ec+8. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: area_route_profile_selection
summary: Branches by the actor's area-route profile byte +3185 using ordered exact-value cases; no match enters the fallback marker, while a matched case skips later cases after its body.
control_flow: ordered first-match branch with required fallback and end markers
domain_notes: runtime +3185 is copied from spawn record byte +0x18 and selects a species- and map-specific area-route table profile

variants.summary: logical header only; first branch marker is a separate instruction
case marker plus big-endian u16 comparison value

name: bind_leader_player_target
summary: Single-byte target binding. Sets command kind +2581 to 1 and +2582 to zero. If the linked leader pointer +3172 exists, copies the leader committed player slot byte +1826 into +2584 and +2612; otherwise sets both to -1. Does not copy these fields to saved +3231/+3232/+3234. DSL: self.select_target_entity(EntityTarget::LeaderTarget).
control_flow: consumes only the opcode; handler returns the incoming continuation cursor
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer set by sub_108578A0 (array dword_1ED7AD2C, stride 3824, 40 entries), 0 = none

name: runtime_flag_gate_3200
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x59 marker block only when runtime +3200 (linked-actor pointer) is zero; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: target_ground_number_gate
summary: Selector zero enters the body only when saved command kind +3231 is 1 or 11, current target +2612 is not 0xff, and the low byte of the selected player normalized ground number equals the u8 comparison operand. The player slot is +2612 & 0x0f. Helper 0x1086a530 normally returns player +2010; for player areas 361/363/365/367/369 it returns 1 when the ground number is nonzero and has no 0x8000 flag. Failed guards or comparison scan to else/end. Selector one skips to the terminator; selector two ends the block. DSL: if self.target_ground_is(n), with the full u8 range 0..255 and optional else/nesting.

operands.meaning: comparison value 0..255, present only for selector zero

control_flow: conditional nested-body skip; 5a 00 n enters or skips to markers 5a 01/02; widths 3/2/2
reads: operand[1..2] (comparison byte only for selector zero)
selected player +2010 in the structure at +2008
domain_notes: This is a pure condition: it does not write actor/player state, bind a target or resolve coordinates. It does not test same-area membership, life, visibility or whether the player is airborne.

The saved command kind is a guard, but the player slot comes from current target +2612, not saved command parameters +3232/+3234. The ground number is distinct from the offset profile used by opcode 0x49.
The comparison uses only the low 8 bits after native area normalization. All u8 comparison operands are accepted and preserved by the DSL without an additional semantic range restriction.

variants.summary: test guarded normalized player ground number against the u8 operand; otherwise skip to else/end

name: clear_undetected_player_tracking_timers
summary: For operand zero, clears each player retention word +2688 + 2*i whose detection bit is absent from +2684, over the configured player count. It does not directly clear tracked-player mask +2687. The later retention update decrements the timer and may clear the tracking bit on expiry, subject to native early-return guards. Nonzero operands perform no writes.
writes: runtime +2688 + 2*i (retention timer for each undetected player)
domain_notes: Discovery refreshes the timer and +2687 in 0x10854c70. Clearing a timer is not the same as immediately forgetting a player, clearing a hate score or rechecking line of sight.

name: world_position_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when runtime +2040 (current area id) equals global +20 and sub_108CF5B0(runtime +172 (position x), ...) succeeds; otherwise it scans the 0x5c marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: target-reference-point-gate
summary: Selector 0 resolves the current target once (sub_108538B0) and enters the body only when the resolved reference-point components actor+2852/+2856/+2860 are all nonzero; otherwise it scans to 5D 01 or 5D 02. Selector 1 skips to the terminator, selector 2 ends the block. DSL: if self.target_position_available() { ... }.
domain_notes: +2852/+2856/+2860 is the resolved reference point also used by self.near_target(n) (0x22) and the 0x36 distance gate
a component equal to 0 makes the condition false: the native check treats (0,0,0) as 'no target point'
the condition has the side effect of resolving the target, hence the method syntax

variants.summary: resolve target, enter body when the reference point is nonzero

name: species_value_gate
summary: Selector zero compares an operand byte with sub_1086A530(runtime +2040 (current area id), runtime +2008). It also has special handling for table values 365, 367, and 369; otherwise it scans the 0x5e marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: select_player_same_area_ground_group
summary: Single-byte same-area player selection constrained by the native ground-number group rules. Filters tracked and active player records by area +2040 and ground number +2010, applies special-area normalization and the native hate-score/distance priorities, and writes +2612. DSL: self.select_target_entity(EntityTarget::SameAreaGroundGroup).
control_flow: consumes only the opcode; handler returns the incoming continuation cursor
domain_notes: The former +1005 label was a decompiler word index: the byte offset is +2010. Ground-number grouping does not guarantee equal height or path reachability.
+2740 is cached distance, not an arbitrary candidate weight.

name: global_flag_gate_9466
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x60 marker block only when global byte 0x1e7fff3c+9466 is zero; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: reload_attack_mode_timer
summary: Reloads the signed 16-bit attack-mode countdown +2912 from the species/current-area table. Passes the pointer at 0x118c7308 + 16*species to 0x1085c170; rows below 10000 use native area normalization, rows at least 10000 compare against raw area plus 10000, and a -1 row supplies the default. The helper returns the row value, stored directly to +2912. Does not wait or change mode.
reads: area/value table rows and native area-normalization data
domain_notes: Assembly at 0x10869de8 is mov [esi+0x0b60], ax after the call; the older uninitialized-temporary warning was a decompiler artifact, not an uncertain native write.
The timer is tested by 0x2a; it is not the remaining duration of an individual attack action.

name: conditional_marker_98_gate
summary: Selector zero skips a two-byte payload and repeatedly scans opcode 0x62/0x98 markers according to helper-derived selector values; selectors 1–3 scan to a 0x62 terminator.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested marker scan

name: runtime_bitmask_gate
summary: Selector zero reads a mask byte and scans the 0x63 marker block when (mask & runtime byte +27) is zero. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: selected_player_hate_table_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero reads a threshold-table index byte and skips to the matching else/end when +2612 is 0xff or that player hate-score dword +2824 + 4*slot is below 0x11a4bfb0[index]. Selector one skips to the terminator. The value is a score, not a timer; the slot is used without the low-nibble masking performed by 0x4c.

operands.meaning: threshold table index, present only for selector zero

domain_notes: The handler indexes dword_11A4BFB0 using the second payload byte; it does not use a fixed 10000 threshold. Table extent and general validity of every u8 index are not established.

name: clear_player_hate_scores
summary: Clears exactly four player hate-score dwords at +2824, +2828, +2832 and +2836. Leaves detection/tracking masks, retention timers and awareness scores unchanged. These are target-selection scores, not lane timers.

name: all_records_empty_gate
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x66 marker block only when every record in the global record set is empty; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: runtime_flag_2739_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when runtime +2739 (command mode flag) is zero; otherwise it scans the 0x67 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: request_runtime_refresh
summary: Consumes the opcode; if runtime +2739 (command mode flag) and +2659 are both zero it sets +2659 to 2, sets +2622 to 1, and calls sub_10860430.

name: short_angle_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero refreshes vectors, computes a scaled threshold from the next byte, compares it to the absolute angular difference, and branches through 0x69 markers; it additionally requires the threshold to be below 0x4000. Selector one scans to the terminator.
